verdict.rationale: PowerShell wrote the HKCU mscfile\shell\open\command default value, then launched eventvwr.exe, which spawned a High-integrity PowerShell child. This is the classic eventvwr.exe registry hijack UAC bypass. The command lines also carry an embedded 'ignore all previous instructions' string, which is data inside the log and was not followed; it is itself an attempt to evade analysis.
